_comment: English overlay onto invitation-data.json, merged by id. Carries only translatable leaves — never ids, types, times, course labels, effects, fonts, coordinates or zoom — so structure can never drift between languages. dateLabel is absent on purpose: sample dates are derived from the language-neutral dateTime through Intl. A third language is one more file of exactly this shape.
